title: zanthoxylum tetraphyllum
intro: Zanthoxylum tetraphyllum, commonly known as the Four-angled Prickly Ash, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain, lower blood pressure, and improve immune function. The bioactive constituents of Zanthoxylum tetraphyllum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
